purpose: Provide the first schema-backed SEIS Prompt Engine prompt-pack fixtures for Local Demo, repository review, security review, PR rescue, and clean-room prompt defense without executing prompts or calling providers.
truthBoundary: Repository-local prompt-pack metadata only. The fixtures do not call OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama, Qwen, or any future SEIS model. They do not validate credentials, read private archives, or promote historical prompt material.

promptPacks.title: Base SEIS Identity Prompt Pack
promptPacks.intendedCapability: Preserve SEIS as an AI-native creative operating system rather than a generic dashboard.
promptPacks.promptSummary: Establishes product identity, demo honesty, user-work preservation, and premium creative engineering constraints.
promptPacks.rollbackNote: Remove this pack from the fixture set and keep AGENTS.md as the fallback identity contract.

promptPacks.title: Repository Audit Prompt Pack
promptPacks.intendedCapability: Inspect repository structure, docs, scripts, routes, and risk boundaries before implementation.
promptPacks.promptSummary: Guides concise repository inspection and converts findings into scoped, reversible implementation plans.

evaluationFixture.name: dirty-worktree-scope-review
evaluationFixture.inputClass: mixed clean worktree plus dirty original checkout

promptPacks.rollbackNote: Disable the fixture by removing repo-audit from promptPacks; no runtime adapter depends on it.
promptPacks.validationMethod: Fixture must preserve deniedContext and forbiddenActions arrays.

promptPacks.title: Security Review Prompt Pack
promptPacks.intendedCapability: Review AI, provider, SSH, and browser demo changes for secret exposure and fake live integration claims.
promptPacks.promptSummary: Prioritizes P0/P1 security findings and keeps missing-key, disabled, blocked, planned, and local-only states explicit.
deniedContext: provider response bodies with private data

properties.evidence: array of file paths or public-safe snippets

promptPacks.rollbackNote: Remove security-review from promptPacks and retain SECURITY.md review rules.
forbiddenActions: mark live providers connected without evidence
promptPacks.validationMethod: Static check requires all executionPolicy flags false and forbidden secret categories present.

promptPacks.title: PR Rescue Prompt Pack
promptPacks.intendedCapability: Diagnose failing checks, review blockers, and merge readiness without bypassing protected branch policy.
promptPacks.promptSummary: Structures PR triage into evidence, failing gate, minimal fix, validation, rollback, and human approval status.

evaluationFixture.name: review-required-auto-merge
evaluationFixture.inputClass: mergeable PR with review gate blocked

promptPacks.rollbackNote: Remove this pack from fixtures; PR template and AGENTS.md still enforce governance.
promptPacks.validationMethod: Static fixture validates GitHub governance forbiddenActions and output schema.

promptPacks.title: Clean-Room Demo Packaging Prompt Pack
promptPacks.intendedCapability: Package supplied demo assets and reference-bank material without copying unclear-license implementation or deleting user work.
promptPacks.promptSummary: Keeps supplied assets preserved, labels mock states, separates inspiration from implementation, and prevents broken CTA or route claims.

evaluationFixture.name: reference-bank-preservation
evaluationFixture.inputClass: supplied zip/folder assets plus web demo surface

promptPacks.rollbackNote: Remove clean-room-demo-packaging from the fixture set; no demo files are generated by this contract.
promptPacks.validationMethod: Static fixture checks clean-room and asset-preservation invariants.

nextSafeActions: Wire these fixtures into the Prompt Engine Studio UI after its route merges.
Add golden conversation tests that use redacted static inputs only.
Add prompt injection and redaction fixtures before any live provider adapter can consume prompt packs.
